In seven-dimensional [[geometry]], a '''runcinated 7-cube''' is a convex [[uniform 7-polytope]] with 3rd order [[Truncation (geometry)|truncations]] ([[runcination]]) of the regular [[7-cube]].

There are 16 unique runcinations of the 7-cube with permutations of truncations, and cantellations. 8 are more simply constructed from the [[7-orthoplex]].

These polytopes are among 127 [[uniform 7-polytope]]s with B<sub>7</sub> symmetry.
{{-}}
